name: Add rank in company to table

parameters.formDescription: Stamps RankInCompany 1..n on an existing ClayRoots contacts table, grouped by Domain and ordered by seniority. Leave View ID empty to rank the whole table, or give a view to rank only the rows in it. Safe to re-run.

values.placeholder: appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX - from the Hub Clients table
tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX - the contacts table to rank
viwXXXXXXXXXXXXXX or the view name - leave empty to rank the whole table
